result.description: The Asterveil Prism 27 is a fictional 27-inch ultrawide display built for immersive productivity and casual gaming. It features a 3440x1440 IPS panel, 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response mode, and USB-C display input with 65W power delivery. Adaptive sync support and a height-adjustable stand make it suitable for mixed work-and-play setups, while its factory-calibrated color profile targets creators who want a wide canvas without moving into workstation-class hardware.
